map.：单件 1.5 m、100 件、损耗 5% → 总料 = 1.5 × 100 ×: : per piece 1.5 m, 100 pieces, loss 5% -> total material = 1.5 x 100 x 1.05 = 157.5 m; unit price 25 yuan/m -> cost 3937.5 yuan.
: net usage 150 m, plus 5% loss and 2% cutting loss -> material = 150 x 1.07 approx 160.5 m, keep margin for seconds.
map.损耗率和裁损区别？: Difference between loss rate and cutting loss?
map.损耗率含工艺回修与次布，裁损是排料边角；两者叠加才是总备料系数。: Loss rate includes process rework and seconds; cutting loss is layout edge waste; both together are the total material coefficient.
map.多幅宽怎么估？: How to estimate with multiple widths?
map.先按单件净面积算，再除幅宽得单件长，乘件数与损耗；窄幅单件长更大。: First compute per-piece net area, then divide by width to get per-piece length, multiply by count and loss; a narrow width gives a larger per-piece length.
